lessons_used: Adding new screens (new_screen) was helpful, winning 5 tests (up to +15.4%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 5 showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen info updates (wait_info) were helpful, winning 3 tests (up to +5.7%), though 1 hurt performance (-6.0%) and 7 showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) were helpful, winning 2 tests (+7.0% and +8.7%), though 2 hurt performance (-3.7% and -3.8%) and 3 showed no clear effect.
Redesigns (redesign) were helpful, winning 1 test (+9.0%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.5%) and 5 showed no clear effect.
Step reordering (reorder) hurt performance in 1 test (-3.8%) and showed no clear effect in 2 tests, while copy changes, hints, notifications, and new flows showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins (e.g., predicting -2.0% vs +8.7% measured, -1.5% vs +9.0% measured) and overestimated changes that hurt performance or had no clear effect.

candidates.title: Account Safeguard Sign-In Screen Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in step with a stage layout framing account sign-in around pet preservation to prevent account resets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported lost or reset pets after signing back in, which is the single largest user complaint.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Desktop Companion Safe

sign_in_options.text: Sign in with existing account to preserve pets, or create a new account safely

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Diagnostic Status on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Display an active status checklist verifying system display resolution, overlay permissions, and render engine readiness while waiting.
candidates.why: 3 support emails mentioned pets not appearing on the desktop, and the home stage has a high mean time of 2336s.

components.text: Checking screen resolution, desktop overlay permissions, and graphics engine readiness...

guard.reason: The waiting screen text focuses purely on technical system diagnostics and loses the required job of showing that the pet is being made.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Interaction Mode Selection Screen
candidates.change: Add a new screen during adoption allowing users to set their pet's default desktop behavior (e.g. Quiet Observer, Active Companion, Playful Explorer).
candidates.why: Adoption completion takes a long median of 89s and mean of 1017s, and users express confusion later about how the pet behaves on desktop.

components.text: Choose between Quiet Observer, Active Companion, or Playful Explorer

guard.reason: Adds a valid new custom behavior selection screen inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen during adoption targets long step duration and has a strong historical track record (+2.5% avg, up to +15.4% wins), but requires building a new screen.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Controls Quick Start Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated quick start guide screen right after home intro detailing essential controls for dragging, hiding, and talking to the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets specifically cite confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.

components.text: Right-click pet for Quick Menu | Double-click to talk | Drag to reposition

guard.reason: text in 'new_quick_controls_guide.components[0].text' has characters outside the allowed set: ['|']

candidates.title: Interactive Companion Pathway Carousel Redesign
candidates.change: Rebuild the path selection screen with an interactive carousel layout highlighting premade vs custom pet options.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a huge discrepancy between median 8s and mean 514s, showing many users stall at path selection.

choose_path.headline: Choose How You Want to Create Your Desktop Pet

path_options.text: Pick a premade companion or generate a custom pet from photo

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Background Engine Performance Tip on Waiting
candidates.change: Display background resource usage and auto-pause behavior information during generation waiting time.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported application stalling or desktop rendering issues upon setup.

components.text: Your pet uses low background CPU and auto-pauses during full-screen games or video calls.

guard.reason: Adds an informative background resource usage tip to the waiting screen without altering core jobs or pricing.

candidates.score_note: Supported by 3 support emails. Wait info updates on home have consistent mild positive results (+1.3% over 11 tests).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Permanent Account Guarantee Copy
candidates.change: Update adoption certificate copy to explicitly state that the pet companion is permanently linked to the signed-in account.
candidates.why: Reduces anxiety around account reset issues which generated 8 support emails last week.

adoption_certificate.body: Once adoption is complete, your pet companion will automatically save to your account and sync across all your desktop devices.
adoption_certificate.headline: Your Pet is Permanently Linked to Your Account
adoption_certificate.hint: You can view your adopted companions anytime from the desktop tray menu.

guard.reason: Updates certificate copy to clarify account sync while preserving the adoption certificate step.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails and cheap to implement, but copy changes historically show no clear effect or slight negative (-0.5%).

candidates.title: Custom Pet Photo Guidance and Template Selector Flow
candidates.change: Add an extra guidance step immediately following path selection to help users prepare high quality pet photos before custom generation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or producing bad visual results.

components.text: Ensure good lighting and centered face for optimal 3D pet generation

new_photo_guidance_step.headline: Select Pet Photo Template for Best Results

guard.reason: 'new_photo_guidance_step.components[0]': photo pickers belong only on upload_photos

candidates.title: First Desktop Summon Tray Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop readiness notification and update hint text on home intro to guide users to system tray options.
candidates.why: The finish step mean duration is 5815s and overall onboarding completion is low (37.4%), indicating users lose track of the app.

home_intro.hint: Check your system tray icon to summon, hide, or adjust pet settings anytime.

guard.reason: Updates home_intro tray notification settings and copy within onboarding bounds.

candidates.score_note: High potential impact addressing huge finish step duration and low overall completion (37.4%), but notifications/hints historically show no clear positive lift.

candidates.title: Sign-In Stalling Resolution Hint
candidates.change: Add a fallback hint on the sign in screen with alternative authentication options if the screen stalls.
candidates.why: 2 support tickets reported that the sign-in screen does not appear or stalls before loading.

sign_in.hint: Having trouble signing in? Click below to try standard browser authentication or guest mode.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' suggests skipping a step
